name: Cinnamon Whiskey
bio: Cinnamon Whiskey is a Ventura County cover band playing hits from the 1960s to today, at venues around the county like Winchesters Grill and Harbor Cove Cafe.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from their website and @cinnamonwhiskeyband.
